topic: Hooks must fail-closed with recovery, never crash on unparseable state
lesson: load_json raises JSONDecodeError on a conflict-markered .factory/*.json, and pre_tool_use/stop_continue call it unguarded — so a mid-merge run.json crashes EVERY hook (Bash/Edit/Write/Stop) with no in-session escape, an unrecoverable loop. Hooks must catch the parse error, deny fail-closed with a clear message, and EXEMPT git-recovery commands (merge/rebase --abort, checkout of the state file) so the session can self-heal.
